title: Require Domain Module Contract Aggregate Shape
forbids: semantic-module contract files delegating through an operation registry, exposing leaf contracts, or owning any authority besides one direct defineDomainSubdomain aggregate
why: The semantic module contract is already the rightful declarative aggregate. It composes canonical leaf operation contracts directly, eliminating a second registry authority while leaving executable binding to the router.
remediate: Default-import each leaf operation contract from ./ops/<operation>/contract.js, compose them inline in one defineDomainSubdomain call, and export only that module contract as default.
message: Domain module contract.ts must expose one default aggregate contract authority only.
